# Slot APIs

The only parts of the core a slot may call or import, besides Vue, Nuxt (`<NuxtLink>`, `<NuxtImg>`, `useId()`, `useRuntimeConfig()`) and `useI18n()`. A theme that keeps to them, to the public hooks and to the slot list may use any license ([theme exception](../../../LICENSE-EXCEPTION.md)). Each declaration is marked `@public` in its TSDoc comment: adding one stays in the contract version, removing or changing one is a contract change ([ADR 0005](../../adr/0005-theme-contract.md); standard, sections 6 and 7). Guide: [../creating-a-theme.md](../creating-a-theme.md).

## Site

The composable for the site identity (name, description, links, modules); Nuxt auto-imports it.

### `useSite`

The site identity from GET /api/site, with app.config.ts's values until it answers or if it fails.

```ts
export function useSite(): ComputedRef<Site>
```

## Category helpers

Import from `~/helpers/categories`; `CATEGORIES` and `CATEGORY_INFO` are re-exported there.

### `isCategory`

Whether `value` is one of the category slugs; narrows it to `Category` when so.

```ts
export function isCategory(value: unknown): value is Category
```

### `categoryColor`

The category's color role: `var(--category-N)`, N being its position in CATEGORIES.

```ts
export function categoryColor(category: Category): string
```

### `categoryOrder`

The display position of a category slug. Unknown or missing slugs sort after every category.

```ts
export function categoryOrder(slug: string | null | undefined): number
```

### `CATEGORIES`

The categories in display order; a category's color role is its position here (`categoryColor`).

```ts
export const CATEGORIES: readonly Category[]
```

### `CATEGORY_INFO`

Per-category data: the pillar (1 or 2) of the two that have one, else null.

```ts
export const CATEGORY_INFO: Readonly<Record<Category, CategoryInfo>>
```

### `~/interfaces/auth`

| Name | Kind | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `AuthRole` | type | The role of a signed-in account: `editor` may open the drafts, `reader` may not. |
| `AuthUser` | interface | A signed-in account as the frontend shows it, built from a Strapi user by `app/helpers/auth.ts`. |
| `AuthUserResponse` | interface | The answer to the session check: the signed-in account, or null when the visitor is signed out. |
| `AuthErrorCode` | type | The error codes of the auth routes. `app/helpers/auth.ts` maps Strapi's messages to these codes, and the forms turn each code into a translated message. |
| `AuthNotice` | type | A notice the sign-in page shows, passed in its `notice` query parameter. |
| `PasswordStrength` | type | How strong a password is, from 0 (empty) to 4 (18 characters or more, or 14 with whitespace); the rules are in `passwordStrength`. |

| `RegisterInput` | interface | The fields of the sign-up form. |
| `ResetPasswordInput` | interface | The fields of the password reset form, after the code arrives by email. |
| `DeleteAccountInput` | interface | The fields that confirm an account deletion. |
| `StrapiAuthUser` | interface | A user of Strapi's users-permissions plugin, as the auth routes receive it. |

#### `AuthUser`

A signed-in account as the frontend shows it, built from a Strapi user by `app/helpers/auth.ts`.

```ts
export interface AuthUser {
  username: string
  /** The address the account signed up with. */
  email: string
  role: AuthRole
  /** ISO 8601 date the account was created; null when Strapi did not return one. */
  createdAt: string | null
}
```

#### `LoginInput`

The fields of the sign-in form.

```ts
export interface LoginInput {
  /** The username or the email address. */
  identifier: string
  password: string
}
```

#### `RegisterInput`

The fields of the sign-up form.

```ts
export interface RegisterInput {
  username: string
  email: string
  password: string
  /** The visitor accepted the privacy notice; the server accepts only `true`. */
  acceptPrivacy: boolean
}
```

#### `ResetPasswordInput`

The fields of the password reset form, after the code arrives by email.

```ts
export interface ResetPasswordInput {
  /** The code sent by email. */
  code: string
  password: string
  /** The new password typed a second time. */
  passwordConfirmation: string
}
```

#### `StrapiAuthUser`

A user of Strapi's users-permissions plugin, as the auth routes receive it.

```ts
export interface StrapiAuthUser {
  id: number
  username: string
  email: string
  /** Whether the email address was confirmed. */
  confirmed?: boolean
  /** Set by an administrator; a blocked account cannot sign in. */
  blocked?: boolean
  createdAt?: string
  role?: { type?: string | null } | null
}
```

### `~/interfaces/comment`

| Name | Kind | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `CommentAuthor` | interface | The public author of a comment, as `toPublicComment` returns it. |
| `Comment` | interface | A comment on an article, as the comments API returns it. |
| `CommentFilter` | type | The sources the comment list can show: all comments, the site's own comments, or fediverse replies. |
| `CommentReport` | interface | A report a reader sent about a comment. |
| `CommentFormData` | interface | What the comment form sends: the author's details, the text and the comment being replied to. |
| `GuestCommentInput` | interface | A guest comment as the form sends it, with the locale of the page. |
| `GuestComment` | interface | A guest comment as the server stores it: the author gets a generated id. |

#### `CommentAuthor`

The public author of a comment, as `toPublicComment` returns it.

```ts
export interface CommentAuthor {
  id?: string | number
  name: string
  /** Kept for the server only: the public shape drops it. */
  email?: string
  /** Null when the author has no avatar. */
  avatar?: string | null
}
```

#### `Comment`

A comment on an article, as the comments API returns it.

```ts
export interface Comment {
  id: number
  /** Strapi's document id, stable across drafts and locales. */
  documentId?: string
  content: string
  /** Whether a moderator blocked the comment. */
  blocked: boolean | null
  /** Blocks replies to the comment and to its thread; the reply button stays hidden. */
  blockedThread: boolean
  /** The moderator's reason for the block, when one was given. */
  blockReason: string | null
  /** The account reference of a signed-in author; null for a guest. */
  authorUser: string | null
  /** The comment was removed, for example because its fediverse note was deleted; the text is replaced by a notice. */
  removed: boolean | null
  /** The moderation state from the CMS: `PENDING` and `REJECTED` are hidden, `APPROVED` is shown. */
  approvalStatus: string | null
  /** Whether the site's owner wrote the comment; the list shows an author badge. */
  isAdminComment?: boolean | null
  author: CommentAuthor
  createdAt: string
  updatedAt: string
  /** The article the comment belongs to. */
  related: {
    id: number
    documentId?: string
  }
  /** Reports readers sent about the comment. */
  reports: CommentReport[]
  /** The replies, nested; present only in the hierarchy view. */
  children?: Comment[]
  /** The parent comment of a reply; null or absent for a top-level comment. */
  threadOf?: {
    id: number
  } | null
  /** The handle of the remote author of a fediverse comment. */
  fediverseActorHandle?: string | null
  /** Link to the remote post of a fediverse comment; only http and https links survive `toPublicComment`. */
  fediverseUri?: string | null
}
```

#### `CommentReport`

A report a reader sent about a comment.

```ts
export interface CommentReport {
  id: number
  /** One of `BAD_WORDS`, `DISCRIMINATION` or `OTHER`; the `string` member lets an unknown code still type-check. */
  reason: 'BAD_WORDS' | 'DISCRIMINATION' | 'OTHER' | string
  content?: string
  createdAt: string
  related?: {
    id: number
  }
}
```

#### `CommentFormData`

What the comment form sends: the author's details, the text and the comment being replied to.

```ts
export interface CommentFormData {
  author: {
    name: string
    email: string
    avatar?: string
  }
  content: string
  /** The id of the comment being replied to. */
  threadOf?: number
}
```

#### `GuestCommentInput`

A guest comment as the form sends it, with the locale of the page.

```ts
export interface GuestCommentInput extends CommentFormData {
  /** The page's locale, for example `en`. */
  locale: string
}
```

```ts
export interface PostCardProps {

}
```

```ts
}
```

#### `PageMedia`

An image, a video or a 3D model file of a page section, validated by the server.

```ts
export interface PageMedia {
  /** A `/uploads/` path, or an http(s) URL on the CMS or a configured media origin. */
  url: string
  /** Alternative text, trimmed; absent when the editor left it empty. */
  alternativeText?: string
  /** Intrinsic width in pixels, when Strapi knows it. */
  width?: number
  /** Intrinsic height in pixels, when Strapi knows it. */
  height?: number
  /** MIME type of the file, when Strapi knows it. */
  mime?: string
}
```

#### `PageLink`

A link of a page section, to another page or to an external address.

```ts

  /** An http(s) or `mailto:` URL, or a path on the site. */
  url: string
}
```

#### `PageSeo`

The search and share metadata of a page, validated by the server.

```ts
export interface PageSeo {
  metaTitle: string
  metaDescription: string
  /** The image of the share preview. */
  metaImage?: PageMedia
  /** Comma-separated robots directives; only the directives Google documents pass. */
  metaRobots?: string
  keywords?: string
  /** An absolute http(s) URL on the site's own origin; any other value is dropped. */
  canonicalURL?: string
}
```

```ts
  question: string
  /** Sanitized HTML of the Markdown answer */
  html: string
}
```

#### `PostListSection`

A list of the newest published posts, optionally filtered by a category or a tag, `section.post-list`.

```ts
export interface PostListSection extends SectionBase<'post-list'> {
  variant: 'cards' | 'list'
  title?: string
  /** Category or tag slug the list is filtered by; never both */
  category?: string
  tag?: string
  /** Number of posts to show, from 1 to 12; the CMS default is 3. */
  count: number
  /** Resolved on the server, newest first; empty when there are none */
  posts: PostListItem[]
}
```

#### `RichTextSection`

A text block written in Markdown, `section.rich-text`.

```ts
export interface RichTextSection extends SectionBase<'rich-text'> {
  /** Sanitized HTML of the Markdown body */
  html: string
}
```

#### `SceneSection`

A 3D model with a poster image, `section.scene`, shown as a background or inline.

```ts
export interface SceneSection extends SectionBase<'scene'> {
  variant: 'background' | 'inline'
  /** A binary glTF file (`.glb`); with any other file the server drops the section. */
  model: PageMedia
  /** The image the server renders, and the static fallback when the model does not load. */
  poster: PageMedia
  /** Alternative text of the poster and of the model. */
  alt: string
  title?: string
  text?: string
}
```

#### `Page`

A page built from sections, as the server returns it after validation.

```ts
export interface Page {
  /** Strapi's document id (the v5 identifier, not the numeric `id`). */
  documentId: string
  title: string
  slug: string
  locale?: string
  seo?: PageSeo
  /** Sections that failed validation are left out */
  sections: PageSection[]
  /** The page in the other locales, for hreflang */
  translations: PostTranslation[]
}
```

#### `SiteImage`

An image of the site, with its alternative text and size when Strapi gives them.

```ts
export interface SiteImage {
  url: string
  /** Text for screen readers; absent when the image has none. */
  alternativeText?: string
  /** In pixels. */
  width?: number
  /** In pixels. */
  height?: number
}
```

#### `AccentColors`

The accent family of one mode, as `#rrggbb`, after the contrast correction. Derived by `server/utils/theme.ts`.

```ts
export interface AccentColors {
  accent: string
  /** The accent mixed into the surface. */
  accentSoft: string
  /** The accent mixed with the ink. */
  accentHover: string
  /** The text colour on an accent surface, the one with the better contrast. */
  onAccent: string
}
```

#### `SiteTheme`

What Strapi's `site-setting.theme` came to after the server checked it against the built theme (ADR 0005, section 8).
Absent when it changes nothing. `accents` holds only modes whose accent differs from the theme's.

```ts
export interface SiteTheme {
  /** The built theme: the only one a build has. */
  id: string
  /** A mode of that theme. */
  defaultMode?: string
  displayFont?: DisplayFont
  /** By mode id. */
  accents: Record<string, AccentColors>
}
```

#### `Site`

The site identity every page reads through useSite() (docs/api.md, GET /api/site).

```ts
export interface Site {
  name: string
  description: string
  url: string
  defaultLocale: Locale
  author: SiteAuthor
  /** Null when the site has no logo. */
  logo: SiteImage | null
  /** Null when the site has no favicon. */
  favicon: SiteImage | null
  /** The share image of a page without a cover; null when unset, and the active theme's image is used instead. */
  defaultOgImage: SiteImage | null
  socialLinks: SocialLink[]
  /** The public contact address; falls back to the configured one when Strapi has none. */
  contactEmail: string
  /** Address for privacy requests, shown on the privacy and unsubscribe pages. */
  privacyContactEmail: string
  /** ISO 8601 date of the last change to the privacy page; empty when unset. */
  privacyUpdatedAt: string
  /** Handle of the support account; the support link is shown only when it is set. */
  supportHandle: string
  /** Which optional modules are on. */
  modules: SiteModules
  theme?: SiteTheme
  /** The page shown at `/` in this locale; absent keeps the blog home */
  homePage?: { slug: string }
}
```

#### `ThemeSettings`

What Strapi's `theme` component held, validated and not yet checked against the theme.

```ts
export interface ThemeSettings {
  /** The theme id Strapi asked for; the server checks it against the built theme before use. */
  themeId?: string
  /** The mode the site opens in, before the visitor picks one. */
  defaultMode?: string
  /** One per mode, the first one kept. */
  accentOverrides?: Array<{ mode: string, color: string }>
  displayFont?: DisplayFont
}
```

#### `AppSiteConfig`

The `site` block of app.config.ts: the fallback when Strapi has no value.

```ts
export interface AppSiteConfig {
  name: string
  description: string
  url: string
  author: { name: string, url: string }
  /** Fallback favicon, used when Strapi has none. */
  favicon?: SiteImage
  socialLinks: SocialLink[]
  support: { buyMeACoffee: string }
  privacy: { contactEmail: string, updatedAt: string }
}
```

```ts
}
```

### `~/interfaces/strapi-seo`

| Name | Kind | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `StrapiMetaSocial` | interface | A social share override of a Strapi SEO component; the frontend does not read it. |
| `StrapiSEO` | interface | The SEO component of a Strapi entry (`shared.seo`), as the CMS stores it. |

#### `StrapiMetaSocial`

A social share override of a Strapi SEO component; the frontend does not read it.

```ts
export interface StrapiMetaSocial {
  id: number
  socialNetwork: 'Facebook' | 'Twitter'
  title: string
  description: string
  /** The image, in the nested Strapi v4 shape. */
  image?: {
    data: {
      attributes: {
        url: string
        alternativeText?: string
      }
    }
  }
}
```

#### `StrapiSEO`

The SEO component of a Strapi entry (`shared.seo`), as the CMS stores it.

```ts
export interface StrapiSEO {
  id: number
  metaTitle: string
  metaDescription: string
  /**
   * The share image. `url` is the flat Strapi field; `data.attributes.url` is the older nested shape,
   * which the pages read when `url` is missing.
   */
  metaImage?: {
    url?: string
    alternativeText?: string | null
    data?: {
      attributes: {
        url: string
        alternativeText?: string
        width?: number
        height?: number
      }
    }
  }
  /** Share overrides per network; the frontend does not read them. */
  metaSocial?: StrapiMetaSocial[]
  keywords?: string
  metaRobots?: string
  /** JSON-LD for the article page; when set it replaces the generated `BlogPosting` graph. */
  structuredData?: Record<string, unknown>
  /** The viewport meta value; the frontend does not read it. */
  metaViewport?: string
  canonicalURL?: string
}
```

### `~/interfaces/theme`

| Name | Kind | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ThemeMode` | type | A mode id declared by the active theme (`noche` \| `dia` in Bogotá). |
| `ThemeModeDefinition` | interface | A mode of the active theme, as the theme module lists it. |

#### `ThemeModeDefinition`

A mode of the active theme, as the theme module lists it.

```ts
export interface ThemeModeDefinition {
  id: ThemeMode
  /** The colour scheme the mode uses; the page's `data-scheme` attribute follows it. */
  scheme: 'dark' | 'light'
  /** The label when the messages have no `theme.modes.<id>` entry; `useTheme` falls back to the id. */
  name?: string
}
```
